verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's first-party Agents SDK and Think harness for Workers advertise built-in MCP support, list "MCP tools" among the harness's built-in tool types, and handle retries on MCP tool calls, so agents running on Workers can consume MCP tools. The evidence never documents how to connect an arbitrary external MCP server as a client, and support exists only inside agents you build with the SDK, not in Workers itself. missing for 10: explicit docs on registering or connecting external MCP servers (URL, auth, transport), client-side configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
